scope: Vilnius 2027 v21: 4 registered lists, 13 statements, 32 quoted evidence rows, 29 scoreable rows.

checklist.requirement: Confirm that the four Vilnius lists and two mayor candidates match the VRK register snapshot used by the build, and that no final list or ballot number is claimed.
After VRK publishes final candidate lists and list numbers (expected 2027-02-05), replace the provisional register page and rerun every source check.
checklist.evidence: VRK final lists and ballot numbers are not published as of 2026-10-26.

checklist.requirement: Read every quoted row in sources_2027.html and confirm that the speaker, date, scope and full proposition support the coded stance. Do not accept a quote merely because the automated substring check passed.
checklist.evidence: 32 quoted rows; 29 are scoreable; 3 are retained as non-scoreable with a stated reason.

checklist.requirement: Confirm that the three non-scoreable rows stay excluded and that unknown rows are not presented as disagreement.
Confirm that Mano Balsas 2024 material is displayed as context only and never enters the 2027 score.
checklist.evidence: Mano Balsas context has status context_only and is not read by the scoring engine.

checklist.requirement: Check that no page calls the result a recommendation, prediction, official ballot or final ranking, and that close/insufficient states are visible.
Verify the ballot explanation against the official 2027 VRK ballot examples and the Rinkimų kodeksas. In particular, verify the number and marking of preference votes and the separate mayoral ballot.
checklist.evidence: Official 2027 ballot examples are not published; the page labels five preference votes as preliminary 2023 practice.

checklist.requirement: Confirm that the published pages store no answers, set no cookies, make no analytics or third-party requests, and keep the CSP closed by default.
checklist.evidence: Static pages use inline data only; no storage, fetch, XHR or external scripts.

checklist.requirement: Test keyboard-only use, visible focus, 200% zoom, a 360 px viewport, reduced motion and a screen reader. Fix any blocker found.
checklist.evidence: Automated axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA scan found 0 violations on six pages and a result state. Manual screen-reader and keyboard review still pending.

checklist.requirement: Run task-based tests with at least five Vilnius voters, including people with low digital confidence. Record where they misunderstand scores, coverage, or the ballot plan.
checklist.evidence: Automated browser flows at 390 px and 320 px only; no real-user testing has been performed.

checklist.requirement: Publish only the clean static output, verify every page and download link over HTTPS, and record the public URL and deployment date.
checklist.evidence: Agent-deployed at https://dziugasmarcenas-ui.github.io/vilnius-2027/ and verified HTTP 200 for six pages and data files on 2026-10-27. Independent human verification still pending.

notes: This file records a pending review; it is not evidence that review happened.
A reviewer must change the relevant status, add a name and date, and update the matching signoff field.
Do not set public_use_allowed to true while any blocked item remains unresolved.
The automated source check proves quotation presence and hash consistency, not correct interpretation or political neutrality.
